headline: Waiting time is the only issue raised at all three branches this week.

shops.overview: Customers praised the coffee and friendly staff. Problems raised: waiting time (mixed views), table cleanliness, oat milk availability.
Customers praised the seating, coffee and staff. Problems raised: waiting time, and a request for a vegan pastry.
One visit reported a price mismatch the staff corrected on the spot; another reported a 10-minute queue.

network_priority.reason: Raised at Central, Riverside and Station; the only problem seen at more than one branch.
network_priority.action: Time queues at all three branches during the morning peak for one week.

requests: Riverside: a customer asked for a vegan pastry option (F08).
mixed_views_note: Central: one visit reported a long queue (F01), another praised quick service (F09).
limitations: Convenience sample of 11 visits, not a survey. One forwarded duplicate (F07) counted once. One comment had no usable detail (F11). Station has only 2 visits.
